title: Stabilize E4M3/E5M2 FP8 activation: per-layer gates, telemetry and retry policy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a robust activation and deployment flow for E4M3/E5M2 FP8 profiles on Hopper GPUs. This ticket implements per-layer gating thresholds, a granular retry/exponential-backoff profile application policy, richer telemetry signals for activation instability, and an automated synthetic calibration pass to catch regressions early. The goal is to enable progressive rollout of FP8 with minimal user-visible quality regressions and clear rollback gates.
acceptance_criteria: Per-layer activation gates implemented in the runtime with configurable thresholds exposed to rollout policies
Synthetic calibration harness that runs nightly and produces a stability score (activation variance, clipping_rate, token-quality delta) for every model-profile pair
Retry policy: k attempts with exponential backoff for profile activation; on repeated failures automatically fallback to INT8 or full-precision variant
Canary gating configured: regional shadowing + 1% traffic canary with automatic rollback on stability_score drop > 0.8 relative to baseline
Telemetry surfaced in Console: per-route activation_variance, layer_clip_rate, golden-seed regression count, and per-profile enablement history
CI integration: calibration job (calibration/hopper-e4m3-e5m2-run) added to PR checks and release pipelines
Runbook updated with clear mitigation steps and postmortem template
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha Patel: Initial spike complete. Identified three telemetry signals that correlate with user-visible quality regressions: layer_activation_variance, per-layer clip_rate, and top-k distribution drift. Draft design posted to Confluence.

2026-03-03 - Marco Chen: Implemented per-layer gate proto and added config knobs to the activation controller. Backend change is behind a feature flag fp8.per_layer_gates. Local experiments on small models show decrease in clipped tokens by ~35%.

2026-03-06 - QA (R. Gomez): Synthetic harness dataset created (5k prompts across instruction, code, and summarization). Running nightly full-sweep against the golden seed set. First run flagged 2 models with high clip_rate on layer 11.
2026-03-09 - Marco Chen: Opened PR runtime#7890 implementing retry/backoff and fallback policy. Added canary job definition ci/canary-fp8-hopper. Requesting review from infra and observability teams.
2026-03-11 - Observability (L. Park): Grafana dashboard prototype available at https://grafana.internal/redwood/fp8-stability. Added panels for activation_variance and per-profile enablement history.
2026-03-12 - Aisha Patel: Running a staged canary in us-west-2 with shadow traffic to validate gating heuristics. Monitoring for regression on eval-set BLEU/ROUGE and token-level perplexity.
Follow-ups: add a lightweight client-side detection to tag anomalous examples that trigger per-layer clipping for faster debugging.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Nightly synthetic runs + CI gate. Phase 2: Shadow traffic across regions for 48h. Phase 3: 1% production canary with automated rollback if stability_score delta > 0.8. Phase 4: Gradual ramp to 10% with staged observation windows. Final: full enablement after 2 weeks of stable metrics.
notes: This ticket intentionally prioritizes observability-first changes so we can confidently detect regressions early. If per-layer gates cause persistent throughput regressions, we'll evaluate a hybrid int8/fp8 route per model family.
